Remark First Mod 1.0.0 - Speed Wand example

File: remark-first-mod-1.0.0-neoforge-1.21.1.jar
Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.1
Tested NeoForge version: 21.1.219
Java runtime: 21
Install the JAR in mods/ on the client and, for multiplayer, the server.
No extra runtime mod is required.

Use a separate creative test world with commands enabled:
/give @s remark_first_mod:speed_wand
Hold the item and right-click into the air.
Speed I lasts 5 seconds; the shared item cooldown lasts 10 seconds.
Changing hands or using another stack does not bypass the cooldown.
Cooldowns are vanilla and are not persisted across reconnect/respawn.

Automated dedicated-server GameTest passed with a simulated player connection.
Actual client visuals, multiplayer and performance have not been verified.
This is an experimental example, not the Remark Studio application installer.

SHA-256:
